bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks, large bags and large purses are prohibited; small purses and fanny packs may measure up to 12 × 12 × 6 inches.
allowed: Small purse or fanny pack up to 12 × 12 × 6 inches
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The Masonic has no venue parking or valet; use paid District Detroit lots or garages. Parking at city meters can be risky because the theater does not permit re-entry.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue FAQ gives no designated rideshare drop-off or pickup area.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Most public shows offer light snacks such as popcorn and chips, and the venue has full-service bars. No outside food or drinks, including gum and candy, are allowed.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: The accessible entrance is the ramp at Second Avenue and Temple Street. The Temple Theatre has an elevated accessible platform and elevators; contact the box office in advance for help.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: No re-entry is permitted once a ticket has been scanned.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The Masonic box office is open Tuesday–Friday from noon to 6 p.m. Guest-list and contest winners need photo ID matching the name given to the box office.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The ticket’s door time is when guests can enter; shows usually begin 60–90 minutes later. The theater asks guests not to line up more than one hour before doors.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
